name: Maestro
purpose: A closer look at what's happening inside a music session.
description: A music-production workspace that turns session signals into inspectable evidence before you act on them.
demoScope: Synthetic session data traveling through the real local WebSocket server, session aggregation, and the real React/Tauri interface. No real audio, DAW, or coaching API is used.
engineeringNotes: Missing or stale audio evidence stays visible in the UI instead of being papered over with a confident guess.
working: Synthetic session registration and track ingest through the real local server
Masking analysis surfaced per track, with the finding kept visible in the UI
Mixer and spectrum views rendered by the real local application
remaining: No AU/VST or FFT extraction from real PCM audio
No Logic Pro or other DAW bridge — the bridge process is a safety stub
No coaching API; the assistant panel is not wired to a model

name: Temper
purpose: Connect the day's recovery, food and training to a plan you can actually follow.
description: A training week that fits real constraints before it becomes an active plan.
demoScope: Two current, verified captures: a real Coach conversation and proposal card, and a 58-second recorded tour across Today, Train, Progress, and Coach with populated synthetic data.
engineeringNotes: Local drafts and commit-time validation keep an impossible schedule visible instead of silently starting it. A pending Coach proposal is shown as a proposal, not an already-applied change.
working: A real Coach thread that proposes a plan adjustment for review, not an automatic change
Today, Train, Progress, and Coach tabs populated with synthetic data in the recorded tour
remaining: No HealthKit or WHOOP sync — readiness and training numbers are synthetic fixtures
The Food tab and a full five-state still set are being re-captured; only the states below are currently confirmed clean
pendingNote: Two prior full still sets were re-shot and discarded after a SwiftData error state was captured by mistake. Only the Coach proposal still and the five-tab video below are confirmed correct as of this capture; a fuller still set is being re-captured and will replace this note.

chapters.title: Walkthrough
chapters.caption: A recorded tour across Today, Train, Progress, and Coach with populated synthetic data.
chapters.alt: Recorded tour of the Temper native app across Today, Train, Progress, and Coach tabs
chapters.transcript: The recording moves through the Today tab's recovery summary, the Train tab's training week, the Progress tab's trend view, and the Coach tab's conversation thread, all populated with synthetic fixture data. No HealthKit or WHOOP data is read.

name: Fantasy Football Control Center
purpose: Bring roster context, player research and weekly decisions into one place.
description: Football information organized into traceable weekly decisions.
demoScope: Seven current synthetic-fixture screenshots covering the weekly decision loop, from a season overview through a proposed trade to a lineup call. These are browser captures of a web tool, not a native application.
engineeringNotes: Immutable snapshots and a separate permission boundary keep review distinct from action.
working: A weekly decision view that ties roster, matchup, and recommendation together
A trade finder that surfaces a candidate, then a side-by-side review before any offer
A start/sit recommendation with its reasoning shown alongside it
remaining: No live league, roster, or draft writes occur; fixtures are synthetic
Projections are illustrative, not a proven forecasting edge
Large-text mobile layout still needs work

name: Season Room
purpose: Keep the ticket, the review and the season record together.
description: A personal betting and season notebook for original receipts, review decisions, and records.
demoScope: Fictional test receipts and recorded views. The season-record view is a separate example, not presented as the automatic result of the receipt review.
engineeringNotes: OCR proposes a transcription; review, revision checks, and idempotent writes protect the record.
working: OCR-proposed transcription held for review before it is written
A season record kept alongside individual receipt reviews
remaining: No live odds feed or automatic settlement
No proven betting edge — this is a record-keeping tool, not a prediction system
